title: TDscript Core 1.1 Error Catalog & Diagnostic Repair Reference
description: Standardized error codes, diagnostic patterns, and autonomous repair heuristics for LLMs
diagnostic_format: Compact single-line format: CODE@line:col message [exp=... got=...]

TDS_E101.name: LEXICAL_ERROR
TDS_E101.cause: Invalid token, unclosed string literal, or unsupported character
TDS_E101.repair_strategy: Close literal or replace invalid token with standard ASCII syntax

TDS_E102.name: SYNTAX_ERROR
TDS_E102.cause: Parser grammar rule violation, missing semicolon or closing brace
TDS_E102.repair_strategy: Ensure correct statement closing and block structure according to grammar.gbnf

TDS_E103.name: UNDEFINED_IDENTIFIER
TDS_E103.cause: Referencing a variable before declaration or outside its scope
TDS_E103.repair_strategy: Declare variable with let or var before referencing it

TDS_E104.name: DIAGNOSTIC_OR_SCOPE_MISMATCH
TDS_E104.cause: Hardware address/register out of allowed CapabilityScope whitelist, or expected value mismatch
TDS_E104.repair_strategy: Replace requested address or register with the authorized target from probe snapshot (e.g. change 0x68 to 0x76)

TDS_E105.name: FORBIDDEN_STRING_CONCATENATION
TDS_E105.cause: Using + operator for string concatenation instead of comma arguments in print() or {var} in LString
TDS_E105.repair_strategy: Change print("Val: " + v) to print("Val: ", v) or use LString L"Val: {v}"

TDS_E106.name: DISPATCH_METHOD_UNKNOWN
TDS_E106.cause: Calling non-existent method on subsystem (e.g. I2C.read_byte instead of I2C.read)
TDS_E106.repair_strategy: Inspect tdscript-api.json and call the canonical subsystem method

E_CAPABILITY.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
E_CAPABILITY.cause: Script attempted action requiring permission bit not granted to current script execution token
E_CAPABILITY.repair_strategy: Request required capability from host or omit restricted subsystem call

SCOPE_VIOLATION.name: ADDRESS_SCOPE_VIOLATION
SCOPE_VIOLATION.cause: Access to hardware address (I2C address, Modbus register, Serial port) blocked by CapabilityScope whitelist
SCOPE_VIOLATION.repair_strategy: Read probe snapshot and restrict commands strictly to authorized addresses

WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT.name: STEP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT.cause: Script exceeded execution step budget (default 100,000 steps) or infinite loop without feed()
WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT.repair_strategy: Ensure loop has termination condition and call WATCHDOG.feed() inside loop body
